fee_notes: Royalty is 8% of Gross Sales from trash compaction services plus 8% of Net Revenue from Ancillary Services. For the first 9 months after opening, no minimum royalty applies. After 9 months, the greater of the 8% calculation or $2,600 per required Truck in operation (the "Minimum Royalty") applies; the minimum increases by $2,600 each time the Additional Truck Threshold is achieved. Brand Fund contribution is 1% of Gross Sales. A separate National Account Fee of 10% of Gross Sales earned from National Account facilities applies for the first 12 months of servicing each facility (in addition to Royalty). Technology fee is currently ~$700/month for 1 owner, 1 salesperson, 1 driver, and 1 Truck; increases for additional users and Trucks; may increase up to 10% per year with 30 days' notice. Multi-unit operators may only be required to pay one technology fee across all agreements.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Beginning on the Business's opening date and continuing until the date that is 9 months after the Business's opening date, 8% of Gross Sales(2) earned, directly or indirectly, from trash compaction services, plus 8% of Net Revenue(2) earned, directly or indirectly, from Ancillary Services(2)
Beginning on the date that is 9 months after the Business's opening date and continuing for the remainder of the Franchise Agreement's term, the greater of: (a) 8% of Gross Sales(2) earned, directly or indirectly, from trash compaction services, plus 8% of Net Revenue(2) earned, directly or indirectly, from Ancillary Services(2); and (b) $2,600 multiplied by the number of Trucks that you are required to have in operation (the "Minimum Royalty").
Brand Fund(3) contribution 1% of Gross Sales
National Account Fee 10% of the Gross Sales earned for services performed by the Business for any and all National Accounts(4)
Technology Fee Currently, approximately $700 per month, assuming you have 1 owner, 1 salesperson, 1 driver, and 1 Truck. Your costs will increase for each additional user and each additional Truck. Upon 30 days' written notice to you, we may increase the fee annually by up to 10% each year.
